fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Optional label for authoring. Category navigation is loaded from the catalog at runtime.

fields.name: root
fields.label: Root Category ID
fields.description: Commerce category ID to use as the menu root. Defaults to "2" (store root).

fields.name: depth
fields.label: Max Depth
fields.description: Maximum number of category levels to render. Defaults to 3.
